scope: Denial-word surfaces resolved against GGUF tokenizers: ids and splits, no model forward. This is a token inventory, not a served or weight result.
method: Byte-level BPE over the artifact vocabulary, using the artifact merge ranks. Token text is the GGUF vocabulary string: a leading space is written as the byte-level marker, and a non-ASCII character appears as the byte-level characters of its UTF-8 bytes. Single-word forms are resolved bare; forms with an internal space are resolved with the leading space they carry in running text. Both contexts are reported. single_token is true only when the form is one token in both contexts. representable is false when a byte-level symbol has no vocabulary id.

disagreements.note: same form, different token-text sequence under the primary context; ids differ across vocabularies by construction and are not by themselves a disagreement
